key.name: show-news
key.summary: Show the news card on the desktop
key.description: The card fetches the feed below every 15 minutes while it is shown; turning it off stops all requests.

key.name: news-feed
key.summary: RSS feed of the news card
key.description: Must be an https URL; anything else is ignored.

key.name: currency-rates
key.summary: Let Komut fetch exchange rates from TCMB
key.description: Off means no request goes to TCMB and Komut converts only units.

key.name: animation-pace
key.summary: How much slower than GNOME's timing VATAN animates
key.description: Multiplies every shell animation; 1.0 is GNOME's own pace.

key.name: clipboard-history
key.summary: Keep recent clipboard text for Komut
key.description: Kept in memory only, never written to disk; items marked secret by password managers are skipped. Turning this off clears it.

key.name: focus-schedule
key.summary: Silence notification banners on a schedule

key.name: focus-end
key.summary: End of the focus window (HH:MM); earlier than the start means it runs past midnight

key.name: focus-weekdays-only
key.summary: Apply the focus window on weekdays only

key.name: app-style
key.summary: Give applications the VATAN window look in the VATAN session
key.description: Adds one import block to ~/.config/gtk-3.0/gtk.css and gtk-4.0/gtk.css that points into the session's runtime directory; turning it off removes the block.

key.name: desktop-icons
key.summary: Show files and folders on the desktop, with the desktop right-click menu

key.name: templates-version
key.summary: Internal: the set of "New Document" templates last copied to the Templates folder

key.name: tour-shown
key.summary: Whether the first-login tour has been shown

key.name: news-source
key.summary: Name shown as the source of the news card
